notes.zh: 注释与代码不一致：opticrum-protocol 注释写 “MatchData — 40-byte”，代码 MATCH_DATA_LEN = 32、from_slice 只要求 ≥ 32B。错误 32 MatchNotExhausted 在提取路径表示“已耗尽”（语义相反）。
notes.en: Comment/code discrepancies: opticrum-protocol says “MatchData — 40-byte”, but the code uses MATCH_DATA_LEN = 32 and from_slice only requires ≥ 32B. Error 32 MatchNotExhausted means “already exhausted” on the extraction path (opposite meaning).

notes.zh: 路由比较的 xUDT 是 (数量, type) 元组（parse_xudt 读 data[0..16]），因此 xUDT 模式下任何改变 xUDT 数量的 Match 更新都会落入 40 UnknownState；提取 / 取回 / 注资实际只对 CKB 模式可达。这是代码行为，非本页推断的规则。
notes.en: Routing compares xUDT as an (amount, type) tuple (parse_xudt reads data[0..16]), so in xUDT mode any Match update that changes the xUDT amount routes to 40 UnknownState; extraction / withdraw / inject are in practice only reachable in CKB mode. This is code behaviour, not a rule inferred by this page.

notes.zh: 输出 Opticrum cell 按 “第一个 lock code_hash 相同且 hash_type = type 的输出” 查找，不比较 args：同一交易中有多个 Opticrum cell 时可能取到别的 cell。lock 不检查任何签名，授权仅靠 “对方 lock hash 出现在输入中”。
notes.en: The output Opticrum cell is “the first output whose lock has the same code_hash and hash_type = type”; args are not compared, so with several Opticrum cells in one tx another cell may be picked. The lock checks no signature; authorization is only “that party’s lock hash appears among the inputs”.

notes.zh: 部署：testnet 通过 type_id 0x1f84…0247 多次迁移（v0.1.1 → v0.3.2）；早期版本的 args（166B）/ data（40–41B）布局不同，本页只解析当前布局。仓库未公布主网部署。
notes.en: Deployment: testnet migrated several times under type_id 0x1f84…0247 (v0.1.1 → v0.3.2); earlier versions used different args (166B) / data (40–41B) layouts and this page only decodes the current one. No mainnet deployment is published.
